 Rockets look to keep win streak rolling vs. Wizards
 The Rockets heads east hoping for another win.
 by Darren Yuvan Nov 15, 2026, 10:30 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Houston Rockets vs. Washington Wizards
 November 15th, 2026
 Time: 6pm CST
 Location: Capitol One Arena - Washington, DC
 TV: MNMT
 Radio: KBME Sports Talk 790 / KLTN 102.9 (en español)
 Probable Starting Lineups 
 Rockets: Fred VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Jabari Smith Jr., Kevin Durant, Alperen Sengun
 Wizards: Trae Young, Kyshawn George, AJ Dybantsa, Anthony Davis, Alex Sarr
 Can the Rockets continue their win streak? Tune in tonight and come chat with us at TDS or on the SB Nation App!
